links.outcome: Hallucinations in RAG chatbot answers grounded in guideline content, manual review of in-scope questions
links.effect: No hallucinations were identified during manual review under the defined test conditions for in-scope questions.
links.quote: For in-scope questions, the chatbot generated responses by summarizing guideline content, and no hallucinations were identified during manual review under the defined test conditions.

links.effect: For out-of-scope questions, the chatbot consistently declined to answer and indicated that the available information was insufficient.
links.quote: For out-of-scope questions, the chatbot consistently declined to answer and indicated that the available information was insufficient.

unlisted_practices: Building RAG reference content by scraping web-based clinical guideline pages using TF-IDF cosine similarity

screen.reason: Describes the development and technical benchmark evaluation of a new guideline-based RAG chatbot architecture for cancer information; does not compare outcomes with or without an operational deployment practice or safeguard.
